name: yolo
description: Agent skills for Ultralytics YOLO and Platform: model selection, dataset annotation, training, tuning, inference, export, and deployment through the Platform web UI, the Python package, and the yolo and ul CLIs.

interface.longDescription: Ultralytics YOLO skills help Codex build computer-vision models end to end, in Ultralytics Platform or local code. Choose the right YOLO model, upload and annotate datasets, train on cloud or local GPUs, improve accuracy, and run inference, tracking, and Solutions such as object counting, then export to ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, Core AI, OpenVINO, or NPU formats or deploy a dedicated endpoint. The skills also script Platform with the ul CLI, and they defer to your installed ultralytics version over their own tables.
defaultPrompt: Run YOLO on a sample image and show me what it detects
Turn my images into a custom YOLO model, labeled and trained in Ultralytics Platform
Deploy my YOLO model as an API endpoint or export it to ONNX, TensorRT, or CoreML
